summary: Log cabin lookout on a St. Joe NF ridgetop in Shoshone County, Idaho; built 1925, abandoned in the 1930s, now listed as gone.

facts.status_note: Forest Fire Lookout Association list marks the site Gone; no source describes what remains

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as hike-in; no source describes current access

notes_for_editor: Brief lists the abandonment as 1940; all three history pages say the 1930s, so the record is corrected. Location conflict in the brief (FFLA 47.28445, -116.05416 vs a second set of coordinates, 47.29747, -116.05012) is not resolved: the second set did not appear on any page read, and the record keeps the FFLA list values. Staffing and fires: no source gives them, so none are in the story. Kresek is credited on the Forest Lookouts page; the book itself was not read. No source describes the site today.
